notes: 第一版美甲系统上线。同一套 wa-cs 现在可以在后台选择行业：餐饮继续按原来的餐饮逻辑跑，美甲会切换成美甲接单逻辑。新增「美甲」行业知识包，机器人懂项目价目、款式确认、卸甲、延长、预约问齐和指甲健康红线；后台「门店与菜单」在美甲行业下会变成「门店与项目价目」，项目、价格、备注、可预约状态都按美甲话术显示。顾客说「给我看价目表 / price list / service list」时，如果上传了价目表文件，机器人会直接把文件发过去，不再多花一次 AI 调用。打开预约后，美甲会收门店、项目/款式、日期时间、人数、称呼电话、旧甲/延长/参考图等信息，但不会承诺技师有空、不会承诺一定能做，也不会自己估计时长。灰指甲、感染、发炎、流脓、流血、伤口、明显疼痛、起水泡等情况会直接转人工并提醒先看医生，不经过 AI 判断。已经装好的餐饮实例不受影响，行业保持原样，配置、聊天记录、预约记录都不会丢。
notesEn: First nail-salon version. The same wa-cs install can now switch industry in the admin: restaurant keeps its existing behavior, while nail salon loads nail-specific intake logic. New nail knowledge covers service lists, style checks, removal, extensions, booking details, and nail-health red lines. In nail mode, the old restaurant menu area becomes an outlets and service-list area with nail-friendly wording for services, prices, notes, and bookable status. When a customer asks for a price list / service list and a file has been uploaded, the bot sends that file directly without spending an AI call. With booking enabled, nail mode collects outlet, service/style, date and time, number of people, name and phone, plus old gel/removal/extensions/reference photo notes. It does not promise technician availability, does not promise the service can definitely be done, and does not invent duration. Fungus, infection, inflammation, pus, bleeding, wounds, strong pain, blisters and similar nail-health issues are handed to a human immediately with a medical-safety reply, without calling AI. Existing restaurant installs are unaffected; industry stays as-is and settings, chats, and reservations are preserved.
